en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father and ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain both narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Ḥusain ibn Yazīd Al-Nawfali, from Ismā’īl ibn Abī Ziyād Al-Sakūni, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Choose pigeons as birds in your houses, for verily they curse the killers of Ḥusain (a.s.).
